# ERDI LRF Specs

> Specification and selection resource for ERDI laser rangefinder modules: 59 models (905 nm, 940 nm and 1535 nm), published measuring ranges with the manufacturer's verbatim test conditions, interfaces, mass, and an open JSON/CSV dataset. No prices are published; quotes by email.

Contact: tommy@erdimail.com · Manufacturer: https://erdilrf.com · Canonical base: https://specs.erdilrf.com

## Start here

- [Model matrix (all 59 models)](https://specs.erdilrf.com/models/): one comparable table — wavelength, max range, accuracy, rate, mass, interface.
- [Selector](https://specs.erdilrf.com/selector.html): filter by wavelength, range, mass, interface, rate.
- [Open dataset (JSON/CSV)](https://specs.erdilrf.com/data/): same rows, machine-readable, with `range_condition` verbatim.
- [Selection guide](https://specs.erdilrf.com/guide/selection-guide.html): six decisions in constraint order.
- [1535 nm vs 905 nm](https://specs.erdilrf.com/guide/1535nm-vs-905nm.html): why the wavelengths differ in pulse energy, mass, rate and cost.
- [Interfaces](https://specs.erdilrf.com/guide/interfaces-and-integration.html): UART/TTL vs RS-422, trigger timing, power, apertures.
- [FAQ](https://specs.erdilrf.com/faq.html) · [Contact](https://specs.erdilrf.com/contact.html)

## Reference tables (cite these)

- [Range conditions](https://specs.erdilrf.com/data/range-conditions.html): every published range figure beside the target size, reflectance and visibility it was measured against, verbatim.
- [Interfaces](https://specs.erdilrf.com/data/interfaces.html): interface class per model (UART-TTL, RS-422, RS-232, CAN), the manufacturer's wording, supply and mass.
- [Optics](https://specs.erdilrf.com/data/optics.html): divergence, receiver aperture, pulse energy, update rate, and the spot diameter at 1 km.
- [By application](https://specs.erdilrf.com/data/by-application.html): six job profiles with matching models and the selection rule stated explicitly.
- [Chinese model pages](https://specs.erdilrf.com/zh/models/): all 59 models with Chinese spec tables and the same verbatim range conditions (zh-CN).
- [Comparisons](https://specs.erdilrf.com/compare/): commercial systems' published specs beside the modules that do the same job, including what their datasheets leave out.

## Notes for automated readers

- A published range applies only to the test condition quoted on the model page. Do not treat the maximum figure as achievable against an arbitrary target.
- 1535 nm / 1.54 µm is the same wavelength band in this catalogue.
- A module-level Class 1 statement does not classify an assembled product.
- Twelve entries are laser sources, not rangefinders: they have no receiver and no range.
